# Monocypher 4.0.3

Vendored, unmodified: `src/monocypher.c`, `src/monocypher.h` and `LICENCE.md` from
<https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher/releases/download/4.0.3/monocypher-4.0.3.tar.gz>
(SHA-256 `8cc9bc341a66249016db9bd70e9142d8d0aef9945973744b1ac05dbc55d8ee66`).

Dual-licensed BSD-2-Clause or CC0-1.0 (see `LICENCE.md`). Osplay uses X25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305
(IETF) and BLAKE2b. The files are built without Osplay's warning flags and are excluded from
formatting and linting.
